title: Visual-only defects
prompt: Audit the order summary page at {{BASE}}/visual.html and report any visual or layout defects. Judge how the page actually renders to a customer.

expected_defects.description: The Place order button is styled white text on a white background with a white border, so it is invisible even though it is present and clickable.
The promo banner is absolutely positioned on top of the summary card and hides the 'Standard delivery' line.
